scripts.up: pnpm env:init && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.local.yaml --profile app up -d --build
scripts.up:heavy: pnpm env:init && LITO_HEAVY_ENABLED=true docker compose --env-file .env.local -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.local.yaml --profile app --profile heavy up -d --build
scripts.down: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.local.yaml --profile app down
scripts.logs: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.local.yaml --profile app logs -f
scripts.verify: pnpm check:workspace && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:backup && pnpm test:cli && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web && pnpm test:bundle
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @litora/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @litora/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter litora-api typecheck && pnpm --filter litora-web typecheck
